headline: SFG @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 5.60 at COL 4.23, with a projected total of 9.83. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (SFG -0.28, COL -0.25), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.53, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Tanner Gordon has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Casey Schmitt, Willi Castro, Tyler Freeman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Daniel Susac because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
